name: cori-clinical.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But tracking continues after Reject.
lesson: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.
summary: www.cori-clinical.com scores 79 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 14 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: tracking continues after Reject.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Decline" and reloading, new cookies __hs_cookie_cat_pref still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, js-eu1.hs-analytics.net drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing…
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.

fix.title: Fingerprinting continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Decline" and reloading, js-eu1.hs-analytics.net drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone.
fix.fix: Block the fingerprinting tag when the visitor refuses, or remove it.

fix.title: 12 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating, /sponsors SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating, /cros SoftwareApplication lacks offers or aggregateRating and 9 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /, for example .gap-\[14px\] > .text-small. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 12 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.
